info.title: Fashlab Studio — Customer API
info.description:
Customer-side REST API for the Fashlab Studio mobile app. Admin functionality is deliberately not exposed here.

### Start here
1. **POST `/auth/guest`** — issues the bearer token everything else uses. Copy the `token` from the response, click **Authorize** above, and paste it in.
2. Browse `/home`, `/products`, add to `/cart` — all of that works as a guest.
3. **POST `/auth/register`** or **`/auth/login`** binds that same token to an account, so the guest cart and wishlist carry over.

### Every response has the same shape
```json
{ "success": true, "message": null, "data": { }, "errors": { } }
```
Branch on `success`, show `message` to the customer, and map `errors` (`{"field": "message"}`) straight onto form validators on a 422.

### Base URL
This webspace applies mod_rewrite patterns but drops the substitution — the same reason the storefront serves `/product.php?slug=…` instead of pretty permalinks — so the API routes on `PATH_INFO` and the base URL ends in `/index.php`. `…/index.php?_route=products` works too, and needs no server support at all.

### Notes
- Prices come back pre-formatted (`"Rs. 6,050"`); the app does no money maths.
- Image URLs are absolute.
- Payment is **Cash on Delivery only** — no gateway is connected.
- If a host strips `Authorization`, send the token in `X-Api-Token` instead.
- No CSRF token is needed; this is a bearer-token API.
